prompt: After `oa_del`, a key that collided earlier in the probe sequence can no longer be found, even though it is still in the table. Tap the faulty line.
explain: Lookups stop at the first EMPTY slot. If a deleted slot becomes EMPTY, any key that was placed *past* it during probing now looks absent. Marking it DELETED (a tombstone) tells lookups to keep probing, while inserts may reuse the slot.
